# Individual Assignment 1: Static Web with HTML5 and CSS3 {.pbp-page-title}

Pemrograman Berbasis Platform (CSGE602022) - diselenggarakan oleh Fakultas Ilmu Komputer Universitas Indonesia, Semester Gasal 2026/2027

**Kontributor:** MUH - Hafiz

***

::: {.callout-important}
### Tutorial 01 adalah Prasyarat Wajib
Individual Assignment 1 **hanya dinilai apabila Tutorial 01 sudah diselesaikan** paling lambat **Rabu, 2 September 2026**. Kalau Tutorial 01 belum dikerjakan, Individual Assignment 1 **tidak akan dinilai**, meskipun sudah dikumpulkan lewat SCELE.
:::

## Tentang Proyek

Proyek Individu mata kuliah ini adalah sebuah **website portofolio pribadi**, dikerjakan sendiri. Individual Assignment dirilis tiap minggu mengikuti topik Tutorial minggu itu, dan tiap assignment melanjutkan langsung dari kode yang kamu buat di Tutorial minggu yang sama.

## Target Tugas Ini

Lanjutkan halaman "About Me" yang sudah kamu buat di [Tutorial 01](../../tutorial/tutorial-1.qmd). Tambahkan **satu atau lebih section baru** ke halaman yang sama, masih murni dengan HTML5 dan CSS3 (belum ada database/MVT - itu bagian Tutorial 02).

Kamu **bebas memilih** section apa yang mau ditambahkan, selama relevan untuk sebuah portofolio pribadi. Beberapa contoh inspirasi:

- **Skills** - daftar kemampuan/teknologi yang kamu kuasai.
- **Experience** - pengalaman organisasi, magang, atau kepanitiaan.
- **Education** - riwayat pendidikan.
- **Projects** - proyek-proyek yang pernah kamu kerjakan.

Karena tugas ini sifatnya lebih bebas dibanding Tutorial, kamu dipersilakan membuat tampilan CSS yang lebih kompleks dari contoh di Tutorial 01 - tambahkan animasi, layout grid yang lebih rumit, atau elemen visual lain sesuai kreativitasmu, selama tetap rapi dan responsif.

::: {.callout-tip}
Desain visual (warna, font, tata letak, dsb.) di contoh Tutorial 01 hanyalah salah satu referensi. Kamu bebas mengubah desain **seluruh** halaman "About Me", bukan cuma section barunya, asal tetap murni HTML5 dan CSS3, terstruktur rapi, dan checklist di bawah tetap terpenuhi.
:::

Checklist minimal untuk tugas ini:

- [ ] Section "About Me" dari Tutorial 01 sudah terisi dengan data kamu sendiri (nama, NPM, foto, bio - bukan lagi data contoh).
- [ ] Minimal satu section baru ditambahkan ke halaman yang sama.
- [ ] Section baru tersebut punya isi yang nyata (bukan `lorem ipsum` atau placeholder kosong).
- [ ] Halaman tetap terlihat rapi di lebar layar desktop maupun mobile.
- [ ] Proyek berhasil dijalankan dengan `python manage.py runserver` tanpa error.

## Pengumpulan

Tugas dikumpulkan lewat slot submisi yang disediakan di SCELE, dalam bentuk **tautan ke commit** (bukan sekadar tautan repositori) di GitHub yang menunjukkan hasil akhir tugas ini, di-*push* **sebelum tenggat waktu** di bawah. Commit yang di-*push* setelah tenggat waktu tidak akan diterima. Pastikan repositori GitHub kamu bersifat **publik**, supaya asisten dosen bisa mengaksesnya untuk penilaian.

## Tenggat Waktu Pengerjaan

Individual Assignment 1 rilis **31 Agustus 2026** (Senin, minggu yang sama dengan sesi lab Tutorial 01) dan dikumpulkan paling lambat **7 September 2026, pukul 12.00 WIB** (Senin minggu berikutnya) - lebih lama dari deadline Tutorial 01 sendiri (Rabu, 2 September 2026).

# Individual Assignment 1: Static Web with HTML5 and CSS3 {.pbp-page-title}

Platform-Based Programming (CSGE602022) - organized by the Faculty of Computer Science, Universitas Indonesia, Odd Semester 2026/2027

**Contributor:** MUH - Hafiz

***

::: {.callout-important}
### Tutorial 01 Is a Mandatory Prerequisite
Individual Assignment 1 **is only graded if Tutorial 01 has been completed** by **Wednesday, September 2, 2026** at the latest. If Tutorial 01 hasn't been done, Individual Assignment 1 **will not be graded**, even if submitted through SCELE.
:::

## About the Project

This course's Individual Project is a **personal portfolio website**, done individually. Individual Assignments are released weekly following that week's Tutorial topic, and each one continues directly from the code you wrote in that same week's Tutorial.

## This Assignment's Target

Continue the "About Me" page you built in [Tutorial 01](../../tutorial/tutorial-1.qmd). Add **one or more new sections** to that same page, still using plain HTML5 and CSS3 (no database/MVT yet - that's covered in Tutorial 02).

You're **free to choose** what section(s) to add, as long as they're relevant to a personal portfolio. Some ideas for inspiration:

- **Skills** - a list of skills/technologies you're proficient in.
- **Experience** - organizational experience, internships, or committee work.
- **Education** - your educational background.
- **Projects** - projects you've worked on.

Since this assignment is more open-ended than the Tutorial, you're encouraged to build a more complex CSS design than the Tutorial 01 example - add animations, more elaborate grid layouts, or other visual elements as you like, as long as it stays clean and responsive.

::: {.callout-tip}
The visual design (colors, fonts, layout, etc.) in the Tutorial 01 example is just one reference. You're free to change the design of the **whole** "About Me" page, not just the new section, as long as it's still plain HTML5 and CSS3, well-structured, and the checklist below is still met.
:::

Minimum checklist for this assignment:

- [ ] The "About Me" section from Tutorial 01 is filled in with your own data (name, NPM, photo, bio - no longer sample data).
- [ ] At least one new section has been added to the same page.
- [ ] That new section has real content (not `lorem ipsum` or an empty placeholder).
- [ ] The page still looks clean at both desktop and mobile widths.
- [ ] The project runs successfully with `python manage.py runserver` without errors.

## Submission

This assignment is submitted through the SCELE submission slot, as a **link to the commit** (not just a repository link) on GitHub that shows this assignment's final result, pushed **before the deadline** below. Commits pushed after the deadline will not be accepted. Make sure your GitHub repository is **public**, so teaching assistants can access it for grading.

## Deadline

Individual Assignment 1 is released **August 31, 2026** (Monday, the same week as the Tutorial 01 lab session) and due no later than **September 7, 2026, 12:00 WIB** (the following Monday) - later than Tutorial 01's own deadline (Wednesday, September 2, 2026).

## Grading Rubric

| Component | Weight | 1 | 2 | 3 | 3.5 | 4 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

All instructions and topics for the week are implemented accurately. | Adds relevant extra features, interactivity, or UI/UX elements beyond the week's instructions. |
| **Code Quality & Structure** | 10% | Code is highly chaotic; logic is unclear; appears to be *copy-pasted* without understanding the underlying structure. | Code is readable but ignores *framework* conventions (e.g., random variable naming, *spaghetti* code). | Code is fairly neat and structured, following the basic HTML5/CSS3 flow taught in Tutorial 01. | Code structure is highly neat, modular, and strictly adheres to HTML5/CSS3 best practices (semantic, *reusable*). | Implements advanced code optimization, cleanly separates *style* concerns, or adds highly informative code comments. |
| **Git & Discipline** | 10% | Submitted late; Git is not used at all (only uploaded ZIP/manual files). | Submitted on time; Git usage is very poor (e.g., only 1 massive *commit* with an unclear message). | Submitted on time; multiple *commits* exist, but commit messages are not descriptive (e.g., "update", "fix"). | Submitted on time. Commit history is routine, reflects gradual progress, and messages are highly descriptive. | Implements organized *branching* for individual features, or maintains a flawless and professional commit history (e.g., *conventional commits*). |
| **Documentation & AI Disclosure + Reflective Question** | 10% | No `README.md` provided; no mention of AI usage whatsoever. | `README.md` exists but lacks project description or clear *setup* instructions. AI disclosure is extremely vague (e.g., "I used ChatGPT"). | Structured `README.md` with clear project description and setup. AI disclosure lists tools used and generally mentions which parts were assisted. | Neat, structured `README.md` with clear weekly setup instructions. Transparent AI disclosure explaining the tools, prompt strategy, and specific assisted parts. Includes AI chat or prompting history/log. | *Open-source* quality documentation (includes the weekly progress). AI disclosure critically analyzes the AI's limitations and highlights manual fixes. |
